title: Redesign Intermediate learning session workload and cross-skill separation
problem: Intermediate 15-minute blocks allocate only 1 activity and 1-3 micro-questions because session-planner drops extra activities via splice(1), while Content Authoring limits activities to single questions. In addition, Listening renders full transcripts on screen, nullifying oral comprehension.
value: Provides pedagogically calibrated 15-minute workloads matching CEFR B1-B2 cognitive requirements, audio-first listening without visual leaks, and valid assessment of learner mastery.

evidence.observation: Session planner splices matching activities down to 1 for non-respond blocks regardless of authored activities.
Contract fixes targetMinutes to literal 15 while blocks contain single activities.
ListeningActivity renders audio transcript unhidden directly above questions before playback.
Normalizer maps authored comprehension activities to a single question array.
Evaluation feedback on incorrect answers discloses missed explanations before retries.

acceptance: Session planner calculates activity allocation using learning objectives and estimated workload instead of rigid 1-activity buckets.
Listening activities default to audio-first with hidden transcripts prior to evaluated submission.
Reading and listening contexts within the same session maintain distinct scenario signatures preventing factual leakage.
Admin Content tools include workload estimation and quality validation warnings prior to publishing.

risk.rollback: Retain published LessonVersion immutability; legacy session snapshots continue using existing schema definitions without mutation.

body:
## Analysis

Audit confirms that Intermediate learning sessions suffer from an acute workload deficit. In a 60-minute session, the planner assigns exactly one activity to Activate, ReadDecode, and ListenReason, and two to Respond. In Format 1.0/1.1 authoring, each activity contains exactly one question, resulting in a 5-question session that learners finish in 3 to 7 minutes. Additionally, ListeningActivity prints the full transcript on screen, turning listening into reading, while reading and listening materials reuse identical characters, departments, and facts.

## Unknowns

Precise reading and listening speeds across target workplace learner cohorts require empirical pilot baseline data. Pilot calibration must test 15-minute block workload formulas against real completion times.
